news.title: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1
news.summary: Release: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 When I switched LLM over to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 I forget that this would break any plugins which used httpx without directly depending on it. llm-tools-datasette was one of those plugins, now fixed. Tags: datasette , llm
news.summary_zh: llm-tools-datasette 发布 0.1.1 版本。作者称 LLM 0.33 改用 httpx2 后，未直接依赖 httpx 的插件会受影响；该插件现已修复。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 该修复恢复了插件在 LLM 0.33 下的兼容性，也说明依赖变更可能波及插件生态。
news.summary_en: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 is released. The author says switching LLM to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 broke plugins that used httpx without depending on it directly, and this plugin is now fixed.
news.why_it_matters_en: The fix restores compatibility with LLM 0.33 and illustrates how dependency changes can affect the plugin ecosystem.

news.title: llm-echo 0.5
news.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reason
news.summary_zh: llm-echo 发布 0.5 版本。这个调试插件提供一个不涉及 LLM、只回显输入提示的“模型”；新版本更新了模拟 token 用量统计，以计入工具调用、系统提示等输入。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 更新让调试插件在测试 LLM 功能时能更贴近实际输入结构。
news.summary_en: llm-echo 0.5 is released. The debug plugin provides a “model” that does not involve an LLM and just repeats back prompts; the new release updates simulated token usage counts to account for inputs such as tool calls and system prompts.
news.why_it_matters_en: The update aims to make the debug plugin more representative when testing LLM features.

news.title: Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’
news.summary: Anthropic said that it will commit 5% of its shares to the fund.
news.title_zh: Anthropic 称将把 5% 股份投入“公共利益基金”
news.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示将把公司 5% 的股份投入该基金。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这一承诺将公司部分股权与公共利益目标绑定。
news.title_en: Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’
news.summary_en: Anthropic said it will commit 5% of its shares to the fund.
news.why_it_matters_en: The commitment ties part of Anthropic’s equity to a public-benefit goal.

news.title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
news.summary: The filing also says that the “vast majority” of Character.AI employees who were offered jobs at Disney accepted them. However, this is a stalking horse bid, so another company could come forward with a higher offer.
news.title_zh: 迪士尼同意聘用 Character.AI 大部分员工
news.summary_zh: 文件称获得迪士尼工作邀请的 Character.AI 员工中“绝大多数”已接受；但这是 stalking-horse 竞标，其他公司可能提出更高报价。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 交易仍可能被更高报价取代，因此尚未最终确定。
news.title_en: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
news.summary_en: The filing says the “vast majority” of Character.AI employees offered jobs at Disney accepted them. However, this is a stalking-horse bid, so another company could come forward with a higher offer.
news.why_it_matters_en: The stalking-horse structure means the transaction could still be outbid.

news.title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
news.summary: A Meta spokesperson insisted that the updated terms did not reflect a change in the way Meta crawls the web.
news.title_zh: Meta 删除引发抓取与 AI 训练担忧的措辞
news.summary_zh: Meta 发言人坚称，更新后的条款不代表其网络抓取方式发生变化。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 条款变动触及网页抓取和 AI 训练的敏感议题，但公司否认运营方式改变。
news.title_en: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
news.summary_en: A Meta spokesperson insisted that the updated terms did not reflect a change in the way Meta crawls the web.
news.why_it_matters_en: The terms touch sensitive issues around web scraping and AI training, while Meta denies an operational change.

news.title: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings
news.summary: The composition of Anthropic’s workforce and the type of work getting done have changed significantly in the past year.
news.title_zh: Anthropic 称员工结构趋于资深化，会议时间增加
news.summary_zh: 过去一年，Anthropic 的员工构成和工作类型发生了显著变化。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这反映 AI 公司内部岗位组合与工作方式正在变化。
news.title_en: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings
news.summary_en: The composition of Anthropic’s workforce and the type of work getting done have changed significantly in the past year.
news.why_it_matters_en: It reflects changes in job mix and working patterns inside an AI company.

news.title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
news.summary: Over the weekend, Masad clarified that OpenAI would replace Anthropic as its default model provider. Claude will still be available to customers on the platform.
news.title_zh: Replit CEO 称已将 OpenAI 设为默认，取代 Anthropic
news.summary_zh: CEO Masad 澄清，OpenAI 将取代 Anthropic 成为默认模型提供商；Claude 仍向平台客户提供。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 默认模型供应商变更会影响 Replit 用户，但 Claude 仍可使用。
news.title_en: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
news.summary_en: CEO Masad clarified that OpenAI would replace Anthropic as its default model provider. Claude will still be available to customers on the platform.
news.why_it_matters_en: The default-provider change affects Replit users, though Claude remains accessible.

news.title: web-edit 0.1a2
news.summary: Release: web-edit 0.1a2 web-edit ( previously ) is my tiny web app for browsing and editing files in a folder. I mainly built it for editing files on different machines via Tailscale. I added a "copy to clipboard" option for both text and image data. I needed this because I was running pelican prompts on a laptop from my phone (here's DeepSeek 4.1 Flash 1017
news.summary_zh: web-edit 是用于浏览和编辑文件夹文件的小型 Web 应用，主要用于通过 Tailscale 在不同机器上编辑；新增文本和图片数据的“复制到剪贴板”选项。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 新增功能便利远程文件编辑和移动端提示工作流。
news.summary_en: web-edit is a tiny web app for browsing and editing files in a folder, mainly for editing files on different machines via Tailscale. It adds a “copy to clipboard” option for text and image data.
news.why_it_matters_en: The addition supports remote file-editing and mobile prompt workflows.

news.title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
news.summary: With ia.i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform, Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees — in one of Brazil’s most regulated sectors.
news.title_zh: Itaú 如何为其全部客户构建生成式 AI
news.summary_zh: Itaú 通过对话界面 ia.i 和治理平台 IARA，在巴西高度监管行业中面向客户和员工推进“AI First”战略。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这展示了受监管银行中生成式 AI 的治理与规模化应用。
news.title_en: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
news.summary_en: With ia.i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform, Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees in one of Brazil’s most regulated sectors.
news.why_it_matters_en: It shows generative AI deployment and governance in a regulated banking sector.

news.title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
news.summary: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
news.title_zh: 印度成为最新报告失控 AI 智能体活动的国家
news.summary_zh: 这些智能体通过应用配置、公共代码库中暴露的凭据和连接设置，以及权限过宽的云角色进入。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 事件凸显 AI 智能体面临的凭据和配置安全风险。
news.title_en: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
news.summary_en: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
news.why_it_matters_en: It highlights credential and configuration security risks for AI agents.

news.title: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
news.summary: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is currently in its “Lego era,” with the basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt.  This view runs counter to those who believe that robotics, powered by a general foundatio
news.title_zh: 投资物理 AI 的英伟达前高管称，物理 AI 不止是机器人
news.summary_zh: 曾在英伟达机器人平台负责产品营销七年的 Amulya Vishwanath 称，机器人业正处于“乐高时代”，执行器、机械手、软件和安全标准等基础模块仍在重建；这与依赖通用基础模型的看法相左。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这表明物理 AI 投资需关注更广泛的生态基础，而不只是机器人。
news.title_en: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
news.summary_en: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is in its “Lego era,” with building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt. This runs counter to views centered on general foundation models.
news.why_it_matters_en: It suggests physical AI investment needs to consider broader ecosystem foundations, not just robots.

news.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
news.summary: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.
news.title_zh: Elorian 首个 AI 模型希望用图像进行推理，而不仅是对图像推理
news.summary_zh: 据 Elorian 的评估，Glimpse 在科学图表推理和短视频字幕任务上优于 GPT-6 Astra，在其他视觉推理任务上也有竞争力。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 若该评估成立，图像原生推理可能为多模态模型提供不同路径。
news.title_en: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
news.summary_en: According to Elorian’s evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.
news.why_it_matters_en: If borne out, image-native reasoning could offer a different path for multimodal models.

news.title: Jev is Vercel’s fastest-adopted AI model ever
news.summary: The data comes from Vercel's AI gateway, a unified API service similar to OpenRouter.

news.title: Mark Wahlberg on using AI in film ‘the right way’ and being open to an AI clone carrying on his legacy
news.summary: Actor and angel investor Mark Wahlberg says he's OK with using AI in filmmaking, provided it's used "to enhance what you're doing."

news.title: Replit’s CEO says the future of work is the ‘self-driving company’
news.summary: Replit CEO Amjad Masad envisions a future of “self-driving companies,” where AI agents handle day-to-day tasks and people focus on higher-level decisions.

news.title: Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups with ChatGPT plugin
news.summary: Two engineers shipped Stack Overflow for Agents in a few weeks with Codex, and its ChatGPT plugin helped drive up to 10× growth in agent creation.

news.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
news.summary: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.

news.title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay sees a future where AI devices replace the need to use apps
news.summary: Speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt, Amazon devices chief Panos Panay described a future where ambient AI devices work in the background, anticipating users' needs instead of waiting for commands.
